course.title: Fundamentals of Planning Process
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Suppose a strong hurricane is approaching fast towards the coastal belt of (15) Bangladesh and the Government has to take some immediate decisions to tackle the imminent disaster. Will a bottom-up approach be more effective than a top-down one in such a case? Why? Why not?
